summary: The B300 launch failure could not be reproduced or root-caused on the assigned gfx950 GPU. Added and regression-tested an independent runtime opt-out for only the Kimi-K3 fused route/pack/MXFP8-quant launch, enabling the issue-requested same-precision field A/B without claiming the unknown crash is fixed.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before regression: all 3 cases failed because SGLANG_DISABLE_KIMI_K3_ROUTE_QUANT_FUSION did not exist.
8 tests verified default fused dispatch, disabled early fallback without JIT probing or launch, explicit re-enable, and downstream standalone activation-quant fallback boundaries.
16 tests and 2 subtests verified environment descriptor behavior and the new handoff gate.
Actual execution on the assigned AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950; sum result 1572352.0. This does not exercise the CUDA-only Kimi-K3 kernel.
Tool availability only: Ruff is not installed in the prepared interpreter, so this check did not run.

gpu_execution_evidence: reports/j-ae3826b76c2e/raw/gpu-environment.txt records torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 executing a deterministic tensor calculation on one AMD Instinct MI350X, gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-. The issue-specific CUDA kernel was not executable.
remaining_limitations: No NVIDIA B300/CUDA hardware, Kimi-K3 weights, eight-GPU TP8/DCP8 topology, or production long-context traffic was available.
The original asynchronous unspecified-launch-failure was not reproduced and its root cause remains unknown.
The switch and fallback selection are verified, but neither the CUDA fused kernel nor its standalone CUDA fallback kernels can execute on gfx950.
No native source changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
